نَفُوضٌ (tropical:) A woman having many children: prolific. (S, A, K.) ＝
-A2- رَجُلٌ نَفُوضٌ لِلْكَلَامِ (tropical:) A man who considers, examines, or studies, speech, or language, or does so repeatedly, in order to obtain a clear knowledge of it. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
